main_finding: The current passive graph omits the active Python stack, including the already-popped event, loop count and the tick owner cursor. Calling run, tick, activate or decide again from its entry is not an exact continuation. A new explicit four-frame conditional-model driver is required; existing passive points cannot be retroactively upgraded.

source_basis.facts: run initializes legs, empty supply, optional route and every START+i*PERIOD tick before count=0; it then pops, sets self.time, checks horizon, increments count, checks20000 and handles one event. The final result includes count. The event-budget early return is separate from the final return.

make_run wraps each handler with before_event, protocol_event and after_event, and wraps only the final return in finish. tick runs A then B or the one supplied owner. activate marks the boundary, retries immutable requests, publishes demand, exchanges messages and resolves deferred reply before calling decide.

The accepted activate implementation is a privately compiled AST. Its remaining tail must retain the two lazy L-view reads, not restore the earlier eager view. inspect.getsource on its generated function is not a sufficient implementation source.
The passive point has an engine graph and just-collected values but no run/tick/activate continuation frames. It deliberately remains resumable=False.

exact_active_call_chain: run: current event already popped; self.time set; count incremented and budget checked; before_event executed; protocol_event returned False for tick/owner_activation
physical handler: tick calls tick(None); owner_activation has already appended its activation_trace row and calls tick(args[0])
tick: owner tuple and current index selected; for an ordinary tick the order is ('A','B')
activate: current owner identity added to activated_boundaries; immutable retry/demand/exchange/deferred-reply prelude already executed
decide: pending/quiet/ACK/deadline admission passed; s and p bound; collect returned information, retry screen and view
only supported suspension: after collect, before record creation, retry publication, final local guard or physical preference/transfer

source_and_domain: exact frozen physical/lazy/communication code identities, contract and initial lawful context identity
conditional model provenance only; no native session, checkpoint, actual hidden state or authority token
initialization_done=True; START/PERIOD/HORIZON and selected action retained unchanged
model_graph: entire engine __dict__, including heaps, calendars, headways, FIFO/waiters, last_arbitration, readiness and dispatch commitments
requests/client_rows/physical_request/event arguments in one alias-preserving graph; no separately decoded copies of the same request
world.e back-reference; observed projected entries, prefixes, lifecycle clocks and completion facts
owner_state pending/quiet/seen/started/reply_budget/deferred reply, demand/inbox/channel state and all monotone sequences
owner_boundaries and activated_boundaries are distinct deduplication sets and both remain unchanged
all existing logs, completed jobs, used action history and unknown phases

run_frame.count: logical event count INCLUDING the current popped event; budget check already passed
run_frame.current_event: the exact tuple (time, priority, sequence, kind, args), with args aliased into the same model graph; never reinsert it
run_frame.activation_trace_already_appended: true only when current_event.kind is owner_activation
run_frame.termination: not_terminal; horizon and count guards for this event already checked

tick_frame.owners: exact tuple ('A','B') for tick or (event.args[0],) for owner_activation
tick_frame.owner_index: current owner index, not the next owner
tick_frame.return_point: after current activate returns, increment index and invoke remaining owners before returning to run

activate_frame.prelude_completed: dedup marker, retry loop, demand publication, exchange and deferred reply are not repeated
activate_frame.tail: original lazy activate tail, including pending/quiet early return and current local L/E checks

decide_frame.owner_s_p: owner plus exact aliases s=owner_state[owner] and p=s['pending']; p can later become an old row when the remainder replaces s['pending']
decide_frame.collected_values: information, retry screen and view returned by this collection, copied with the engine and all frame aliases in ONE graph operation
decide_frame.not_required_locals: ack is dead after the collect site; record/known/tray/try-body locals do not exist yet
decide_frame.remainder: the exact original record creation through final pending=None or retry return; no recollection or replacement of collected values on resume

proposed_minimal_interface.start: start_conditional(supplied_initial_context, fixed_action) performs the unchanged initialization once and enters an explicit-frame loop.
proposed_minimal_interface.advance: advance_to_collection_or_terminal(state) executes original event statements until the supported post-collect program counter or the exact original terminal return.
proposed_minimal_interface.fork: fork_conditional(continuation) clones the model plus ALL frames and collected values together; external recorders are not retained.
proposed_minimal_interface.resume_first_gate: resume_same_action(continuation) completes decide remainder -> activate tail -> tick remaining owners -> run.after_event -> next heap pop. It does not change action or read actual data.
proposed_minimal_interface.counterfactual_gate_deferred: Only after exact same-action continuation passes may a separate reviewed suffix API change a field proved unused in the executed prefix. Phase B cannot revise the first return or initial route/supply action.
proposed_minimal_interface.single_use: A continuation instance has explicit consumed/terminal state. A fork is made before consumption. Reusing a consumed instance is rejected rather than scheduling duplicate work.
proposed_minimal_interface.yield_semantics: A yield is a model control-flow event outside physical time; it does not enqueue an event, increment sequence/count, drain the heap or advance the clock.

implementation_proof_requirements: AST-split the frozen decide exactly at its unique collect statement; concatenating prefix and remainder restores the original normalized AST.

Derive the accepted lazy activate AST from the frozen original transformation and bind its recursive code signature; then split immediately after self.decide. Do not silently use the old eager activate.

Lower only tick's owner cursor and run's dispatch control into explicit frames. All physical handler statements, before/after hooks and arithmetic expressions remain byte/AST bound to the frozen source.

Preserve the original generated run wrapper: before_event once, protocol_event once, physical handler once when False, after_event once. The event-budget early return must still bypass finish as the old function does.

Keep logical event count inherited across clones and resumes. Compute accounting charges initialization, validation, copied graphs and every actual continuation evaluation; candidate budgets32/4 and unknown status do not change.

The first executable gate should only compare same-action continuation output, chronology and internal framed state against uninterrupted execution. No optimizer or actual-state filter is installed in that gate.

source_derived_counterexamples.shortcut: Call run() on a passive engine clone.
source_derived_counterexamples.failure: Reissues initial E supply and optional route, starts legs and all periodic ticks again, resets local count to0 and changes IDs/order/budget.

source_derived_counterexamples.shortcut: Resume by popping the next heap event.
source_derived_counterexamples.failure: The current owner event has already left the heap. Its decision remainder, activation tail, possible second owner and after_event are lost.

source_derived_counterexamples.shortcut: Reinsert the current event then process it again.
source_derived_counterexamples.failure: Duplicates count, activation_trace and hooks. Boundary dedup may then suppress the still-unexecuted decision rather than repair it.

activated_boundaries already contains (time,owner), so it returns immediately. Removing that marker instead repeats immutable retries/demand/exchange/reply work and can create new request/message sequences.
Re-reads ACK/deadline and repeats collect and its validation/cost. It is not the continuation of the already-returned information/screen/view and obscures future action-change semantics.

source_derived_counterexamples.shortcut: At an A pause inside tick, return to the heap before B.
source_derived_counterexamples.failure: tick executes A then B inside one handler. B must run before the next heap event, even if another same-timestamp owner event is queued.

source_derived_counterexamples.shortcut: At a B pause, restart tick from A.
source_derived_counterexamples.failure: A's earlier work is repeated or suppressed by dedup; B's current unfinished remainder is not restored by either outcome.

source_derived_counterexamples.shortcut: Re-sort or regenerate same-timestamp work using owner names.
source_derived_counterexamples.failure: tick and A activation have priority99, B activation100, and existing sequence breaks ties. Original tick scheduling and owner notification history must remain exact.

source_derived_counterexamples.shortcut: Reset count or recount only heap entries at resume.
source_derived_counterexamples.failure: At count20000 the current handler is allowed; the next in-horizon pop returns unknown at20001 before its handler and without finish. Resetting count grants extra work.

source_derived_counterexamples.shortcut: Leave an event beyond HORIZON on the heap or increment count for it.
source_derived_counterexamples.failure: Original run pops it and sets self.time first, then breaks before count increment and before_event. A terminal state must retain this exact stop behavior.

source_derived_counterexamples.shortcut: Use the old pending row as a live alias after retry replacement.
source_derived_counterexamples.failure: The decide retry remainder publishes once, increments sequences and assigns a new pending dict. The old p and owner_state pending now differ by design; both frame lifetimes must be correct.

source_derived_counterexamples.shortcut: Rebuild request/event args independently from JSON.
source_derived_counterexamples.failure: ACK and retry handlers mutate shared request/client rows; equal-valued detached objects can change future terminal flags, retries and notifications.

necessary_small_pure_checklist_not_run: Inverse AST/code identities for initialization/run dispatcher, tick cursor, lazy activate split and decide split.
Fake A pause inside tick: resume exact remainder then B once, then after_event once; no new pop before B.
Fake B pause inside tick: A prelude not repeated and B action not omitted by existing activated boundary.
Single-owner owner_activation pause: activation_trace already appended exactly once; later same-timestamp tick dedup preserved.
Two equal-time events with different sequence/priority: current event not reinserted and remaining heap order unchanged.
Unknown first read -> one fresh publication -> pending replacement -> later collection, with exact message IDs/sequence and no extra retry.
Known A immediate/not-before and B default/prefer8 remainders, retaining all current/wire/occupancy guards and finally behavior.
Count19999/20000/20001 boundaries, empty heap, exactly HORIZON and first event beyond HORIZON; final finish versus early-return behavior.
One-graph alias/cycle preservation across engine, frames, pending/client/physical request and current event args; clone mutation and repeated-consumption rejection.
Forbidden initial/action-prefix changes and unsupported arbitrary program counters reject explicitly.
No actual ID parsing, native session, future actual outcome or hidden state may enter the continuation constructor.
A later bounded real-input test must compare complete outputs and event/message chronology; none is run by this design task.
limitations: Even an exact resumed conditional model is not a native state or online protection certificate.
Actual opaque IDs still need evidence-constrained relations, not string parsing or dropping identity fields.
Initial-model hypotheses require complete lawful history/action/observation coverage before actual-data filtering can be sound; current96 endpoint conformance does not prove that coverage.
No field is supplied from actual final outcomes to fill omitted Python frames or physical history.
The current six-point passive diagnostic remains a separate immutable120s preparation and is not changed by this design.
